subject: What is the purpose of default.txt?

messages.author: 8d4cd0b2463d6bd3
messages.subject: What is the purpose of default.txt?
parts: Hi,  I successfully installed irace and run the ACOTSP example.  I was wondering what is the purpose of the default.txt file, as it does not seem to be mentioned in "irace-parameter tuning package - User's Guide.pdf" ?

messages.author: 8d4cd0b2463d6bd3
messages.subject: Re: What is the purpose of default.txt?
parts: Ah, I found the answer in the guide.  It is for specifying a starting point (tuning) for the irace algorithm.

On Saturday, 30 September 2017 22:10:50 UTC+1, Daniel Grace wrote:
Hi,  I successfully installed irace and run the ACOTSP example.  I was wondering what is the purpose of the default.txt file, as it does not seem to be mentioned in "irace-parameter tuning package - User's Guide.pdf" ?

messages.author: 8d4cd0b2463d6bd3
messages.subject: Re: What is the purpose of default.txt?
parts: It is covered in section 5.5 of the guide.

messages.author: 1e8700780c0e6d69
messages.subject: Re: What is the purpose of default.txt?
parts:
Hello Daniel, 

The default.txt file corresponds to the definition of the initial configurations (in the user guide). The initial configurations file should contain one or more configurations (assignment of parameter values for tour algorithm) that are used to start the search of parameters.

Let us know if you have more questions, 

Leslie.
